meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 在指定的 NanoClaw 群里搭一个持续保存的 wiki 知识库:建 wiki/ 与 sources/ 目录和初始 index.md、log.md,写入容器技能与群 CLAUDE.md 的 wiki 段落,重启后就能往群里投喂资料。
howto.when: 当你提到 “add wiki”、“wiki”、“knowledge base” 等关键词时触发。它会先读 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式说明,再和你一起确定用哪个群、wiki 主题和来源类型。

say.text: 给这个群加一个 wiki 知识库
say.note: 先读模式说明,再问你选哪个群

say.text: 这个 wiki 的主题是行业资料,来源主要是网页和 PDF
say.note: 据此设计目录结构和容器技能

say.text: 把这个 URL 的全文下载到 sources/ 里
say.note: 用 bash 抓全文,而不是只要摘要

howto.what_en: Adds a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group: creates wiki/ and sources/ folders with initial index.md and log.md, writes a container wiki skill and a wiki section in the group CLAUDE.md, then restarts so you can feed it sources.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base" and similar. It first reads Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern, then works with you to pick the group, topic and source types.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group
say_en.note: Reads the pattern, then asks which group

say_en.text: The wiki topic is industry docs, mostly web pages and PDFs
say_en.note: Uses this to design folders and the container skill

say_en.text: Download the full text of this URL into sources/
say_en.note: Uses bash for full text, not just a summary
